User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the FinWave application, holding core profile information.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

registrationDate.description: The date and time when the user registered for the application.

lastLoginDate.description: The date and time of the user's last login.

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: Represents a bank account owned by a user, used for financial transactions and balance tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BankAccount entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this bank account. (Relationship: User 1:N BankAccount)

accountNumber.description: The unique account number of the bank account.

accountName.description: A user-friendly name for the account (e.g., 'My Savings Account').

bankName.description: The name of the bank where the account is held.

balance.description: The current monetary balance of the account.

status.description: The current operational status of the bank account (e.g., 'Active', 'Inactive', 'Closed').

createdAt.description: The date and time when the bank account record was created.

DepositProduct.title: DepositProduct
DepositProduct.description: Defines the characteristics and terms of a specific deposit product offered by the bank.

id.description: Unique identifier for the DepositProduct entity.

name.description: The official name of the deposit product (e.g., 'Fixed Deposit 12 Months').

description.description: A detailed description of the deposit product features and benefits.

interestRate.description: The annual interest rate offered for this deposit product (as a decimal, e.g., 0.05 for 5%).

minimumDepositAmount.description: The minimum principal amount required to open this deposit product.

termInMonths.description: The duration of the deposit product in months (e.g., 6, 12, 24).

currency.description: The currency in which the deposit product is denominated.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the deposit product is currently available for new deposits.

productCode.description: A unique code assigned to the deposit product for internal identification.

Deposit.title: Deposit
Deposit.description: Represents a user's specific fixed deposit, linking to a deposit product and tracking its lifecycle.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Deposit entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns this deposit. (Relationship: User 1:N Deposit)

depositProductId.description: Reference to the DepositProduct this deposit is based on. (Relationship: DepositProduct 1:N Deposit)

bankAccountId.description: Reference to the BankAccount from which the initial deposit was made or where interest is credited. (Relationship: BankAccount 1:N Deposit)

initialAmount.description: The original principal amount of the deposit.

currentAmount.description: The current value of the deposit, including any accrued interest.

startDate.description: The date when the deposit officially started.

maturityDate.description: The date when the deposit will mature.

status.description: The current status of the deposit (e.g., 'Active', 'Matured', 'Early Withdrawn', 'Closed').

interestEarned.description: The total interest earned on this deposit up to the current date.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Records all financial movements and activities associated with a user's accounts or e-wallets.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who initiated or is associated with this transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

transactionType.description: The type of financial transaction (e.g., 'Debit', 'Credit', 'Transfer Out', 'Bill Payment', 'E-Wallet Top-up', 'QR Payment').

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction.

transactionDate.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred.

description.description: A brief description or memo for the transaction (e.g., 'Online shopping', 'Salary deposit').

status.description: The current status of the transaction (e.g., 'Completed', 'Pending', 'Failed', 'Cancelled').

sourceBankAccountId.description: Optional reference to the user's BankAccount from which funds originated. (Relationship: BankAccount 1:N Transaction, where BankAccount is source)

destinationBankAccountId.description: Optional reference to the user's BankAccount where funds were received. (Relationship: BankAccount 1:N Transaction, where BankAccount is destination)

beneficiaryId.description: Optional reference to a registered Beneficiary if the transaction was a transfer to them. (Relationship: Beneficiary 1:N Transaction)

eWalletId.description: Optional reference to the user's EWallet if the transaction primarily involved it (e.g., top-up, transfer from e-wallet). (Relationship: EWallet 1:N Transaction)

externalPartyName.description: The name of an external entity or person involved in the transaction, if not a registered beneficiary or internal account.

externalPartyIdentifier.description: An identifier for the external party (e.g., account number, biller ID, phone number).

Beneficiary.title: Beneficiary
Beneficiary.description: Stores details of recipients (individuals, businesses, billers, or e-wallets) registered by a user for easier fund transfers.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Beneficiary entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who registered this beneficiary. (Relationship: User 1:N Beneficiary)

beneficiaryName.description: The full name or official name of the beneficiary.

bankName.description: The name of the bank if the beneficiary is a bank account.

accountNumber.description: The account number if the beneficiary is a bank account.

eWalletProvider.description: The provider of the e-wallet (e.g., 'OVO', 'GoPay') if applicable.

eWalletIdentifier.description: The identifier for the e-wallet (e.g., phone number, email) if applicable.

billerName.description: The name of the biller if the beneficiary is a biller.

billerIdentifier.description: The identifier for the biller (e.g., customer ID, subscription number) if applicable.

addedDate.description: The date and time when the beneficiary was added to the user's list.

EWallet.title: EWallet
EWallet.description: Represents a user's linked external e-wallet, displaying its balance and status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the EWallet entity.

userId.description: Reference to the User who owns/linked this e-wallet. (Relationship: User 1:N EWallet)

providerName.description: The name of the e-wallet service provider (e.g., 'OVO', 'GoPay', 'DANA').

eWalletIdentifier.description: The unique identifier for the user's e-wallet account (e.g., phone number, email used for the e-wallet).

balance.description: The current monetary balance in the e-wallet.

currency.description: The currency of the e-wallet balance.

linkedDate.description: The date and time when the e-wallet was linked to the FinWave app.

status.description: The current status of the e-wallet link (e.g., 'Active', 'Disconnected', 'Pending').

definition.description: Stores individual user profiles. Access is restricted to the owning user or Admin.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique ID of the user.

System audit logs. Restricted to Admin only.
